Distance from A to B is 45.39 km, so distance from A is 45.39 - 20.867 = 24.523 km. That's close to SC-06 at 24.261 km. The discrepancy between 25.696 and 24.523 suggests maybe a break with some reflection? Let's check route km.

3 at 11.253 km loss 0.06 (SC-02 11.06)

5 at 16.158 km loss 0.26 (SC-04 15.782)

7 at 24.865 km loss -0.8 dB (gain?) (SC-06 24.261)
8 at 25.696 km end loss null reflectance -18.3 (this is end of fibre, i.e., break)

So event 8 at 25.696 km is end. That's about 1.4 km beyond SC-06 (24.261). Could be break between SC-06 and SC-07, at ~25.7 km.

From B side:

Event 4 at 20.867 km end => 45.39 - 20.867 = 24.523 km from A, near SC-06 24.261.

So from B, the last event before end is at 18.515 km from B, which is 26.875 km from A, between SC-06 and SC-07, then end at 20.867 km from B which is 24.523 km from A, just after SC-06. So break is between SC-06 and SC-07, around 24.5-25.7 km.

Could be a fibre break at route_km ~25.7 km (or 24.5 km). Need more precise. Let's run OTDR event table at 1550 nm from site A.

checklist.note: A-TX 0.67 dBm (in spec -1 to +2). B-ODF no light, B-RX no light

checklist.item: Review site notes for recent field work
checklist.note: Site notes: outage reported 2026-10-21 11:55, road works around km 27. SC-05 re-entered 2026-10-24. A-ODF cleaned 2026-10-25

checklist.item: Run embedded OTDR from site A and B
checklist.note: Embedded OTDR A shows fibre end at 25.696 km (expected 45.39). Event 7 at 24.865 km loss -0.8 dB (gain) anomaly. B side shows end at 20.867 km

checklist.item: Run OTDR event table at 1550 nm from site A (or B) if needed
checklist.note: OTDR 1550 from A: end at 25.713 km, last event at 24.87 km with -0.73 dB loss (gain)

checklist.item: Inspect suspect connectors (A-ODF, B-ODF, MID-PP)
checklist.note: Connectors A-ODF and B-ODF inspected: end faces appear clean, no obvious damage

checklist.item: Correlate OTDR events with route map to locate fault
checklist.note: OTDR from A ends at 25.713 km, from B ends at 20.86 km corresponding to ~24.5 km from A, consistent with fibre break between SC-06 (24.261 km) and SC-07 (27.338 km). Trace shows abrupt loss after 25.68 km.

checklist.item: Submit diagnosis with evidence
checklist.note: Diagnosis prepared: fibre break at ~25.7 km, repair required

args.evidence: A-TX output normal 0.67 dBm, B-ODF reads no light. Performance monitoring shows RX power normal until 2026-10-21 then -40 dBm with RX_LOS alarm active. OTDR 1550 nm from site A shows fibre end at 25.713 km, and embedded OTDR shows end at 25.696 km, indicating open fibre between SC-06 (24.261 km) and SC-07 (27.338 km) near road works reported around km27. Trace shows abrupt transition to noise floor after 25.68 km.
